description: Shows who is signed in: user id and username, whether a developer profile exists, the active developer account with the user's role, the API URL and where the key came from (environment or credentials file; never the key itself). Read-only. Use it to confirm the login before creating or publishing games; to list or switch accounts use gamealia_accounts. Fails with a hint to call gamealia_login when not logged in.
name: gamealia_whoami
title: Who am I
